stories.title: Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya ifadeye çağrıldı

en.title: Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya summoned for statement
en.summary: Capital Markets Board initiated an investigation into Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya and her husband İlyas Kaya for alleged violations of capital markets law.

stories.title: Son dakika... Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya hakkında soruşturma izni: Eşi İlyas Kaya ile birlikte ifadeye çağrıldı!

en.title: Investigation authorization granted for Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya: Summoned for statement along with husband İlyas Kaya
en.summary: Investigation authorization was granted against Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya and her husband İlyas Kaya within a fund investigation scope. The couple will provide statements.

stories.title: Tunç Soyer'den Cemil Tugay'ın AKP'ye transferi sonrası açıklama: 'Başın öne eğilmesin güzel İzmir'

en.title: Tunç Soyer statement after Cemil Tugay's transfer to AKP: 'Don't bow your head, beautiful İzmir'
en.summary: Detained former İzmir Mayor Tunç Soyer responded to Cemil Tugay's decision to join the AKP, calling on İzmir residents to maintain dignity and courage in difficult times.

stories.title: İzmir Şehir Tiyatrosu Danışma Kurulu'ndan toplu istifa: 'Cemil Tugay’ın kararını kabul etmiyoruz!'

en.title: Mass resignation from İzmir City Theatre Advisory Board: 'We do not accept Cemil Tugay's decision'
en.summary: Members of İzmir Metropolitan Municipality City Theatre Advisory Board collectively resigned following Cemil Tugay's move to the AKP, emphasizing need to preserve the theatre's independence and public trust.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA… İzmir Belediye Başkanı Cemil Tugay AK Parti’ye katıldı: AK Parti ile İzmir'i ayağa kaldıracağız

en.title: Breaking News... Izmir Mayor Cemil Tugay joined AK Parti: We will revive Izmir with AK Parti
en.summary: Cemil Tugay, who resigned from the Republican People's Party and had been serving independently as Izmir Metropolitan Municipality Mayor, has joined the AK Parti. President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan presented him with the party badge.

stories.title: Cemil Tugay’ın AKP'ye geçmesi sonrası İzmir’den ilk istifalar geldi

en.title: First resignations from Izmir following Cemil Tugay's move to AKP
en.summary: Following Izmir Metropolitan Municipality Mayor Cemil Tugay's participation in an AKP group meeting, initial resignations have emerged from the Izmir Metropolitan Municipality.

stories.title: Yusuf Beyazıt kimdir? TBMM Başkanvekilli Yusuf Beyazıt kaç yaşında, nereli? Yusuf Beyazıt'ın önceki görevleri neler?

en.title: Who is Yusuf Beyazıt? TBMM Deputy Speaker Yusuf Beyazıt age, birthplace? What were Yusuf Beyazıt's previous positions?
en.summary: Yusuf Beyazıt has been appointed to the TBMM Group Deputy Chairmanship vacated by Bekir Bozdağ in the AKP. President Erdoğan announced this development.

stories.title: Öznur Tugay kimdir, AKP'ye geçen Cemil Tugay'ın eşi kaç yaşında, nereli? 'Beni boşar demişti'

en.title: Who is Öznur Tugay, wife of Cemil Tugay who moved to AKP, age and birthplace? 'He said he would divorce me'
en.summary: Information is provided about Öznur Tugay, wife of Cemil Tugay who resigned from the Republican People's Party on June 18, 2026, and now serves independently before recently joining the AK Parti.

stories.title: Merkez Bankası Başkanı Karahan'dan enflasyon mesajı

en.title: Central Bank Governor Karahan delivers inflation message
en.summary: Turkey's Central Bank Governor Fatih Karahan delivered remarks on inflation at an investment summit focused on creating value for the future.

stories.title: TCMB Başkanı Karahan’dan enflasyon mesajı: 'Dezenflasyon yeniden ivme kazanacak'

en.title: TCMB Governor Karahan on inflation: 'Disinflation will regain momentum'
en.summary: The Central Bank Governor stated that tight monetary policy is slowing domestic demand and disinflation will accelerate, with energy prices identified as a key inflation risk and policy tools to remain firmly deployed.

stories.title: Son dakika... İzmir Büyükşehir Belediye Başkanı Cemil Tugay, resmen AKP'ye katıldı: Rozetini Erdoğan taktı!

en.title: Breaking news... İzmir Metropolitan Mayor Cemil Tugay formally joined the AKP: Erdoğan pinned his badge!
en.summary: İzmir's metropolitan mayor, previously elected with opposition votes, formally joined the ruling party in a ceremony where the president pinned his party badge.

stories.title: Cemil Tugay AK Parti'ye katılacak: İşte İzmir'de çözüm bekleyen sorunlar! Vatandaşlar yıllardır proje bekliyor

en.title: Cemil Tugay will join AK Parti: Here are the problems awaiting solutions in İzmir! Citizens have been waiting for projects for years
en.summary: İzmir's metropolitan mayor joined the ruling party in a ceremony where the president pinned his badge, as the city faces longstanding infrastructure needs.

stories.title: İstanbul’da pastırma yazı etkisi: Hafta sonu sıcaklık 25 dereceye çıkacak

en.title: Pastırma effect in Istanbul: Weekend temperature to reach 25 degrees
en.summary: Istanbul is expected to experience no precipitation over the next week, with daytime and nighttime temperatures differing by up to 8 degrees, and weekend temperatures reaching 25 degrees Celsius.

stories.title: AK Parti'de Bekir Bozdağ'ın yerine gelecek isim belli oldu

en.title: Name of successor to Bekir Bozdağ in AK Party announced
en.summary: Following Bekir Bozdağ's resignation due to health issues, the AK Party appointed a new deputy group chairman. President Erdoğan announced that Yusuf Beyazıt, a Member of Parliament from Tokat, was selected for the position.

stories.title: Fed tutanakları (FOMC) ne zaman, saat kaçta açıklanacak?

en.title: When will Fed minutes (FOMC) be released and at what time?
en.summary: Millions are awaiting the release of Federal Reserve minutes that establish the Fed's policy direction, with widespread interest in the announcement timing.

stories.title: Bakan Uraloğlu: Kent içi raylı sistemlerde 3,25 milyar yolcuya hizmet verildi

en.title: Minister Uraloğlu: 3.25 billion passengers served on urban rail systems
en.summary: Turkey's urban rail system network expanded from 281 kilometers in 2002 to 1,054.7 kilometers by 2026, serving 3.25 billion passengers cumulatively, according to the Transport and Infrastructure Minister.

stories.title: Kuyumcudan altın alırken dikkat! Limit yükseltildi, zorunluluk getirildi

en.title: Be careful when buying gold from jewelers! Limit raised, obligation introduced
en.summary: Turkey increased identification thresholds for cash, currency, and jewelry transactions from 185,000 to 370,000 Turkish lira as part of anti-money laundering and counterterrorism financing measures. Electronic transfer thresholds were raised from 15,000 to 30,000 lira.
